name: Relais de Mémoire intact
prompt:
Original medieval fantasy RTS concept, hand-painted 2D with credible material details and readable silhouette. Match the supplied style references: brushwork, proportions, lighting, detail density, camera and faction palette. References show OTHER subjects: do not reproduce their identity, equipment or add them to the image. Exactly one complete centered subject, slightly elevated three-quarter view, ample empty margin around all extremities. Transparent background, no ground, scenery, base, interface, typography, logos or watermark. Never draw a checkerboard. If native transparency is impossible use a plain white background for extraction.
Material palette: aged ivory limestone, weathered bronze, pale white-blue Echo, small touches of old dark wood and red memory thread.
Subject: ONE compact ancient freestanding medieval memory relay monument, three pale limestone standing slabs with bronze interlocking hoops and inset tiny blue-white Echo crystals; strict geometric institutional craftsmanship, delicate channels and notches but NO words or runes, entirely isolated architectural object with no soil, grass, pedestal terrain, landscape or people; readable ritual function, symmetrical slender silhouette. ONE isolated physical stone-and-metal site structure; no terrain or environment. Match style references for brushwork and MATERIAL ONLY, never copy their subject. No readable text, no added people, no painted ground.
CRITICAL FRAMING: show the ENTIRE isolated subject, 15 percent empty margin on all four sides, about 65 percent of square canvas occupied. Preserve the exact SUBJECT SHAPE specified above, use references for PAINTING STYLE only and do NOT imitate their geometry. No atmospheric haze. Background must be uniform white if alpha unavailable.
